top_signals.title: Global Leaders on Redrawing the Supply Chain Map
top_signals.summary: Beto Abreu, CEO, Suzano; T.H. Helene Budliger Artieda, State Secretary, Swiss Confederation; T.H. Kitila Alexander Mkumbo, Minister of State, President’s Office for Planning & Investment, United Republic of Tanzania; and Masayuki Omoto, President & CEO, Marubeni Corporation discuss how companies and governments are adapting supply chains to geopolitical and economic disruption with Bloomberg’s Shery Ahn at the 2026 Bloomberg New Economy Forum in New Delhi. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: Turkey Lets Lira Fall Quicker to Avoid Future Devaluation Risk
top_signals.summary: Turkey is allowing the lira to slide more quickly in order to prevent sharper weakness in the longer term, central bank Governor Fatih Karahan told investors at meetings in Bangkok, according to people with direct knowledge of the matter.

top_signals.title: Kotak Sees $5 Billion Inflows in India Private Debt in Two Years
top_signals.summary: Global and domestic investors could invest as much as $5 billion into India’s private credit market over the next two years, according to Kotak Alternate Asset Managers Ltd., which manages over $22 billion in assets.

top_signals.title: PM says housework makes her busier than male predecessors
top_signals.summary: "In the morning, I bathe, fix breakfast and then wash dishes, not to mention apply makeup," said Sanae Takaichi.
